values: Finalize the role and permission matrix for all five system roles
Defines secure access boundaries for every AI feature
The approved matrix covers create, read, update, workflow, analytics, and AI permissions for each role.
Replace free-text user roles with a validated Role enum
Prevents unauthorized access to AI insights and model controls
The database, API validation, seed data, and frontend types use ADMIN, MANAGER, INVESTIGATOR, ACTION_OWNER, and STAFF.
Add Admin access to protected frontend routes and navigation
Provides access to the Admin AI governance dashboard
An ADMIN user can sign in and reach the Admin workspace without redirection or permission errors.
Implement Admin authorization override across protected APIs
Admin can perform permitted operations across all departments while every action is audited.
Build the cross-department incident oversight dashboard
Displays enterprise risk trends and AI alerts by department
Admin can filter incidents by department, severity, status, category, and date and open a permitted record.
Implement department management for create, update, deactivate, and view
Maintains clean department metadata for analytics models
Admin can manage departments without deleting historical incident relationships.
Implement user management for create, update, deactivate, and role assignment
Controls which users can access role-specific AI features
Admin can manage user status, department, and role with validation and audit history.
Add controlled Admin incident correction with mandatory reason
Corrected records improve AI training data quality
Admin corrections require a reason and preserve before-and-after values in the audit log.
Create the AuditLog data model and reusable audit service
Tracks AI recommendations, overrides, and model decisions
Authentication, role, incident, workflow, review, closure, and AI events record actor, time, action, entity, and changes.
Build the Admin audit log viewer with filters and export
Shows AI recommendation usage and human overrides
Admin can search and export audit events by user, department, event type, entity, and date.
Define and implement sensitive-data masking rules
Prevents sensitive text from being exposed to unauthorized AI views
Restricted fields are masked by role and are excluded from AI prompts unless explicitly authorized.
Secure evidence storage and authenticated file access
Controls evidence supplied to AI summarization
Files are stored outside public paths, checked for allowed type and size, and served only after incident authorization.
Build system configuration for categories, severity, SLAs, and workflow values
Provides governed labels and thresholds for AI and analytics
Admin can update approved configuration values without code changes and changes are audited.
Build enterprise incident analytics across departments
Shows organization-wide frequency, ageing, resolution, and risk concentration
Dashboard metrics use live incident data and support department and date filters.
Build the AI data-quality monitoring dashboard
Measures completeness and consistency before model use
Admin sees missing-field rates, invalid values, class balance, and records excluded from model training.
Implement AI model registry and model-version metadata
Tracks predictive-risk and similarity model versions
Each model version records training date, dataset version, metrics, status, and deployment history.
Build AI model health, accuracy, and drift monitoring
Alerts Admin when predictive performance or data patterns change
The dashboard displays accuracy, drift indicators, failures, latency, and the active model version.
Implement model retraining approval and rollback workflow
Keeps model changes under human governance
Admin can approve, reject, deploy, and roll back a model version with an audit trail.
Run security and authorization penetration tests
Includes AI endpoints, prompt inputs, and model administration
Automated and manual tests prove cross-role and cross-department access is denied unless explicitly permitted.
Run concurrency, performance, and availability tests
Measures AI endpoint latency separately from core workflow latency
The agreed concurrent-user target is met and slow AI jobs do not block incident operations.
Implement backup, recovery, monitoring, and production deployment procedures
Includes AI artifacts, vector indexes, and model metadata
A documented deployment, backup, restore, monitoring, and rollback exercise succeeds in the target environment.
Complete Admin UAT, training, and handover documentation
Explains AI limitations, governance, and override responsibilities
Admin stakeholders approve the workflows and receive operating and support documentation.

values: Enforce own-department access on every Manager incident API
Restricts department AI insights to authorized managers
A Manager cannot read or modify an incident outside the department in the signed token.
Restrict investigator and action-owner assignment candidates to the Manager department
Prevents cross-department AI recommendations and assignments
Assignment APIs and dropdowns return only eligible active users in the Manager department.
Redesign the Manager dashboard around department risk and workflow queues
Creates the home for role-specific AI risk insights
Dashboard shows submitted, investigating, action overdue, review pending, high-risk, and closed counts from live data.
Add accept, reject, comment, and revision-request decisions
Stores manager feedback that can improve AI classification quality
Manager can accept, reject, or request revision with mandatory comments and the reporter can view the decision.
Add controlled incident editing with validation and audit history
Improves structured fields used by analytics and AI
Manager can edit authorized incident details and every change is validated and audited.
Can later use workload-aware AI assignment suggestions
Only accepted incidents can receive an eligible department investigator and the transition is audited.
Build Manager review of submitted investigation findings
Displays AI similarity evidence beside human investigation findings
Manager can approve investigation findings or return them to the assigned investigator with comments.
Block Action Owner assignment until root-cause submission is approved
Prevents AI action recommendations from using incomplete RCA
The API rejects assignment until required investigation and root-cause fields are complete and approved.
Support assignment of one or more Action Owners to action items
Enables AI monitoring per action and owner
Manager can assign each action to an eligible owner and every owner sees only assigned actions.
Create multiple corrective and preventive action items
Provides structured action data for similarity and effectiveness models
Manager can create multiple actions with type, priority, owner, due date, status, and description.
Add action priority, due-date, and escalation management
Feeds overdue and completion-risk AI features
Manager can change authorized action priorities and due dates with reason and notifications.
Build existing-control assessment and new-control planning
Supplies control-effectiveness analytics and AI recommendations
Manager can record control type, effectiveness, failure reason, required improvements, owner, date, and status.
Build management Review records with outcome and comments
Shows AI evidence without replacing the Manager decision
Review captures reviewer, date, outcome, comments, lessons learned, dissemination, and follow-up details.
Add lessons-learned dissemination and follow-up scheduling
Manager can select audiences, schedule follow-up, and track dissemination status.
Enforce closure prerequisites and create a structured closure record
Creates reliable labels for resolution-time and severity models
Close is allowed only after all actions are completed, controls are verified, and review is approved.
Tracks recurrence outcomes for AI evaluation
Authorized Manager can reopen a closed incident with reason while preserving closure history.
Upgrade the incident register with server-side search, filters, sorting, and pagination
Supports filtered AI and analytical investigation
Register supports ID, title, category, severity, status, location, date, reporter, and owner filters at scale.
Add authorized CSV and report export
Exports AI scores with model version and explanation
Export respects department access and clearly labels calculated and AI-derived fields.
Build the Incident Frequency Trends widget
Uses time-series statistics and anomaly detection
Manager can view daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly trends filtered by category, severity, and location.
Build the Root Cause Distribution widget
Highlights frequent and emerging root-cause patterns
Widget provides category and sub-category drill-down using approved root-cause data.
Heatmap compares control type, effectiveness, department context, and incident frequency.
Manager can compare average and outlier resolution times by severity, category, and team.
Build Overdue Actions and Open Incident Ageing widgets
Uses SLA rules and due-date risk indicators
Widgets show ageing and overdue items by owner, priority, severity, and SLA threshold.
Integrate Predictive Risk Scoring with explanation and human override
Predicts escalation, recurrence, and prolonged resolution
Each score shows model version, key factors, confidence context, and a recorded Manager override option.
Minimum viable historical dataset and model registry
Compares initial and final severity to improve triage
Manager can view over-rating and under-rating patterns over time by category and department.
Show AI-recommended similar incidents, lessons, controls, and actions
Recommendations include relevance scores, source links, model version, and an option to accept or dismiss.
Create Manager workflow integration and regression tests
Tests permissions and AI-assisted decision paths
Automated tests cover valid and invalid state transitions, department boundaries, closure guards, and AI failures.
Complete Department Manager UAT and workflow documentation
Documents AI interpretation and human accountability
Managers approve the end-to-end lifecycle and receive role-specific operating guidance.

values: Enforce assigned-investigator ownership on every investigation API
Protects investigation data and role-specific AI results
An Investigator can read or update only incidents assigned to the signed-in user.
Create the structured Investigation data model and migration
Creates reliable investigation features for AI analysis
The model supports lead, team, dates, method, findings, factors, witnesses, evidence, and timeline.
Build the investigation workspace with save-draft capability
Provides the interface for AI-assisted investigation
Assigned Investigator can save incomplete work without advancing the incident state.
Allows collaboration context for AI and audit records
Lead Investigator can add eligible team members while access remains controlled.
Add investigation start date, end date, and method fields
Supports duration analytics and method recommendations
Dates and approved methods are validated and included in the investigation record.
Add findings summary and contributing factors
Supplies structured data for clustering and prediction
Investigator can record validated findings and multiple approved contributing factors.
Add witness records, evidence references, and timeline of events
Provides source material for AI timeline and evidence summarization
Investigator can add authorized witness references, files, and chronological events.
Create the complete Root Cause Analysis data model
Creates structured training data for root-cause similarity
Root cause stores category, sub-category, description, analysis method, and analysis detail.
Add systemic-issue flag and linked-incident relationships
Enables recurrence detection and incident graph analysis
Investigator can flag systemic issues and link authorized related incidents with reasons.
Implement investigation submission and Manager return-for-revision workflow
Records human approval around AI-assisted findings
Submission validates required fields, locks approved findings, and supports revision comments and resubmission.
Upgrade the Investigator dashboard with status, priority, and due-date filters
Prioritizes cases using permitted risk signals
Dashboard lists only assigned work and supports search, status, severity, and due-date filters.
Build Similar Incidents search using text embeddings
Ranks historical incidents by description, category, location, and root cause
Investigator receives a ranked list with similarity score, matched fields, and authorized source links.
Surfaces repeated root causes and previous analysis methods
Panel compares root-cause categories, descriptions, methods, controls, and outcomes.
Groups incidents by latent category, location, and root-cause patterns
Investigator can inspect clusters and open permitted incidents without exposing restricted data.
Add AI-assisted evidence and timeline summarization
Summarizes authorized evidence metadata and event chronology
Generated summary is clearly labeled, source-linked, editable, and never overwrites Investigator findings.
Add AI suggestions for investigation method and contributing factors
Suggests methods such as 5 Whys, Fishbone, Fault Tree, or Timeline Analysis
Suggestions show reasons and require explicit Investigator selection or dismissal.
Add explainability, feedback, and human-override capture for Investigator AI
Collects relevance feedback for improving similarity and recommendation quality
Every AI result shows explanation and model version and records accept, dismiss, or override feedback.
Create Investigator unit, authorization, and workflow tests
Covers AI failure and fallback behavior
Tests cover ownership, drafts, submissions, revisions, file access, similarity access, and invalid state transitions.
Run AI relevance evaluation with a reviewed incident sample
Measures Similar Incidents and recommendation usefulness
Evaluation records precision-oriented relevance results, reviewer feedback, and known limitations.
Complete Investigator UAT, training, and role documentation
Explains responsible use of AI suggestions
Investigators approve the workflow and receive investigation, privacy, and AI-use guidance.

preview: Enforce assigned-investigator ownership on every investigation API

values: Enforce assigned-action ownership on every Action Owner API
Restricts action-related AI suggestions to the assigned owner
An Action Owner can read and update only explicitly assigned action items.
Create the multiple-action data model and migration
Provides structured action data for similarity and effectiveness models
Each incident supports multiple action records with unique IDs and relationships.
Add action description, type, priority, owner, and due date
Creates features for overdue and risk prediction
Every action validates Immediate, Corrective, or Preventive type, priority, owner, and due date.
Build the Action Owner dashboard for assigned work
Shows AI-ranked urgency and due-date risk
Dashboard displays only assigned actions with incident context, priority, due date, status, and search filters.
Build action detail and progress-update screens
Displays relevant AI recommendations beside the action
Owner can update Not Started, In Progress, and Completed states with required notes.
Add completion date and automatic overdue-state calculation
Feeds overdue analytics and completion-risk models
Completion date is captured and overdue state derives from due date and status.
Add action evidence attachments and secure viewing
Provides evidence metadata for AI effectiveness review
Owner can upload approved files and authorized reviewers can view them securely.
Add verification notes and action-effectiveness assessment
Completion requires verification notes and supports Manager-verified effectiveness status.
Prevent incident review until all required actions are completed
Prevents incomplete action data from reaching AI closure analysis
The API rejects review while any required action is incomplete or unverified.
Records reasons when AI or Manager review finds insufficient action
Manager can return an action with comments and owner can revise and resubmit.
Uses SLA and predicted completion risk
Owner receives in-app notifications before due date and when an action becomes overdue.
Build action history and audit timeline
Shows AI suggestions and owner decisions over time
Action page shows status, assignment, date, evidence, review, and recommendation events in order.
Build Similar Actions Analysis using embeddings and clustering
Finds repeated corrective measures across incidents
Owner sees authorized similar actions, completion rates, effectiveness, and relevance scores.
Highlight recurring fixes with poor effectiveness
Signals when repeated actions are not preventing recurrence
The system identifies repeated low-effectiveness actions and explains the supporting history.
Add AI recommendations for effective actions and controls
Suggests actions and controls from relevant successful incidents
Recommendations include source incidents, effectiveness evidence, and accept or dismiss feedback.
Predicts actions likely to miss their due dates
Risk indicator includes factors, model version, and no automatic status change.
Build Action Effectiveness scoring and outcome feedback
Combines verification, recurrence, timeliness, and review outcomes
Score is explainable, Manager-reviewed, and linked to the supporting data.
Create Action Owner unit, authorization, and workflow tests
Covers AI failure and recommendation fallback behavior
Tests cover ownership, progress, overdue logic, evidence, completion guards, revisions, and AI result access.
Run usability and AI recommendation feedback sessions
Measures whether recommendations help owners complete effective actions
Feedback is recorded, prioritized, and used to adjust the final workflow.
Complete Action Owner UAT, training, and role documentation
Explains AI suggestions, due-date risk, and human accountability
Action Owners approve the workflow and receive operating guidance.

preview: Enforce assigned-action ownership on every Action Owner API

values: Create an authenticated API that returns only incidents reported by the signed-in Staff user
Restricts staff AI suggestions and history to owned incidents
Staff cannot list or open incidents reported by another user.
Replace the static My Incidents page with live data
Shows AI-assisted status explanations only for owned incidents
Counts and incident cards load from the own-incidents API and support loading, empty, and error states.
Fix the broken Staff report navigation route
Restores access to the future AI-assisted report form
The Staff navigation opens the configured incident submission route.
Add formatted Incident ID, incident occurrence date and time, and reported date
New incidents receive a unique human-readable ID and valid occurrence and report timestamps.
Add dependent category and sub-category fields
Supports AI classification and consistent analytics
Sub-category choices depend on the selected approved category and both values are stored.
Validate department selection and incident routing
Routes the report to the correct department AI and Manager queues
Only active departments can be selected and the receiving Manager queue is correct.
Add save-draft, submit, and submission confirmation workflow
Allows AI completeness guidance before final submission
Staff can save a private draft, submit it once required fields are complete, and receive a reference ID.
Improve evidence upload, preview, removal, and authorized viewing
Provides safe source material for optional AI summarization
Allowed files can be previewed or removed before submission and viewed after authorization.
Show rejection comments and revision requests
Explains missing information identified by Manager or AI completeness checks
Staff sees decision type, comments, date, and required revisions on the owned incident.
Allow controlled editing and resubmission after a revision request
Captures improved structured data without losing the original report
Only revision-requested fields are editable and resubmission preserves version history.
Add incident status timeline and in-app notifications
Explains major workflow and AI-assisted triage events
Staff sees submitted, decision, investigation, action, review, and closure milestones without restricted details.
Add search and filters to My Incidents
Helps users find previous reports and AI suggestions
Staff can search owned incidents and filter by status, severity, category, and date.
Add AI-assisted category and sub-category suggestions
Uses report text to recommend classifications
Suggestions include a reason and require Staff confirmation or correction before submission.
Approved category taxonomy and training data
Add AI-assisted initial severity suggestion with human confirmation
Predicts a starting severity from historical records
Suggested severity is clearly labeled, explainable, editable, and never automatically final.
Show possible duplicate or similar incidents before submission
Uses text similarity to reduce duplicate reports while preserving valid reporting
Staff sees a limited, privacy-safe similarity notice and can continue submission with a reason.
Add an AI completeness assistant for missing or unclear report details
Assistant identifies missing date, location, chronology, category, or evidence context without inventing facts.
Creates a concise title and summary from Staff-entered text
Generated text is labeled, editable, and stored only after explicit Staff confirmation.
Complete responsive design, accessibility, and keyboard navigation
Ensures AI suggestions and explanations are accessible
Staff workflows pass agreed responsive, contrast, label, focus, and keyboard checks.
Create Staff authorization, form, revision, and AI-assistance tests
Tests safe fallback when AI services are unavailable
Tests prove own-only access, validation, attachments, revisions, suggestions, overrides, and core submission without AI.
Complete Staff UAT, training, and user guidance
Explains that AI suggestions support but do not replace user judgment
Staff participants approve the reporting and tracking workflow and receive concise guidance.
